description: This is a PHPUnit test class for EmployeeTerminationDao, testing methods related to employee termination records in the OrangeHRM system. It includes setup, test cases for saving and retrieving termination records, and fetching termination reasons.

classes.name: EmployeeTerminationDaoTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test case for EmployeeTerminationDao, containing setup and test methods for employee termination record operations.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the EmployeeTerminationDao instance and populates test data from fixture file.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeTermination
methods.description: Tests saving a new EmployeeTerminationRecord and asserts correct data persistence.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeTermination
methods.description: Tests retrieval of an EmployeeTerminationRecord by ID and verifies its properties.

methods.name: testGetTerminationReasonList
methods.description: Tests fetching the list of termination reasons and verifies their count and names.
